motion.frame: STATIC. Frame-to-frame size delta 0.00-0.03px per 0.5s (measured, all notes). Zero digital zoom pulses, zero drift, zero shake detected. All perceived movement = his own body.
motion.our_rule: baseline static; slow push (1.06-1.10, ~1.1s ease) only at fx-marked moments; shake opt-in only

colour.our_rule: grade 'natural': keep phone WB (Hao's is accurate + his brand is paper-white), sat x1.35, con x1.04, exp x1.05. Never copy his wall warmth onto a white wall (v6 jaundice lesson).

layers.notes: 1 line, 5-12字, swaps per phrase; sometimes 2-3 lines accumulate for a quoted formula; parenthetical annotations OK 脖子短的(长颈鹿)

layers.colour: gold #F0C800 (concept) / red #F01010 (warning) / teal + red-orange gradient rare
